name: Translation to Ello
summary: In Duskwood, you carry Sirra Von'Indi's translation to Lord Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire. It belongs to the Abercrombie story, and the letter bears news of the hermit's writings.

sections.title: A Belated Realization
sections.body: Abercrombie's requests sent travelers across Duskwood for days. The elderly hermit asked for thread, preserved reagents, and personal belongings, claiming he needed them to survive. Sirra Von'Indi finally deciphered his private parchment, revealing the truth: the kindly old man is an unhinged embalmer. The gathered components went into a terrifying weapon of revenge aimed at Darkshire.

sections.title: The Road to Darkshire
sections.body: When the translated letter reaches Lord Ello Ebonlocke, the mayor's face loses all color. Whatever noble motives brought you to help, delivering those final supplies let Abercrombie finish his monstrous creation, Stitches. The letter's delivery sets the behemoth marching east along the road from Raven Hill Cemetery. Any Night Watch patrol in its path is slaughtered.

faq.q: What is written in the translated letter?
faq.answer: Sirra fears Abercrombie has done something unspeakable. Take the translated letter urgently to Lord Ello Ebonlocke, who can judge the danger to Darkshire.
Sirra Von'Indi is a scholar living in Darkshire. His skill with language and analysis lets him decipher Abercrombie's cryptic notes and letters when others cannot read the script.

faq.q: Why does Lord Ello blame the player?
faq.answer: Lord Ello's reaction comes when he reads the translated letter. Bring him the warning as quickly as possible.

faq.q: What happens immediately after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Take the translated letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire. His response and the danger in the letter come to light when he reads it.

faq.q: Where does Stitches go after this?
faq.answer: Stitches is tied to the road between Raven Hill Cemetery and Darkshire. His part in Abercrombie's plot emerges through the investigation.
After you deliver the letter, Lord Ello sends adventurers onward to Bride of the Embalmer.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you face a painful lesson in Duskwood's treachery: misplaced trust in the woods can endanger an entire settlement of innocent citizens.
